Families of Contrasts among Means

Source: R/contrast_family.R
contrast_family.Rd

Build a standard family of contrasts among the means of a model term, as a matrix for the ctrmatrix argument of contrastmeans. The families are those of emmeans, with the same coefficients and names:

"pairwise", "revpairwise"

all pairs, earlier minus later level (or later minus earlier);

"trt.vs.ctrl"

each level minus the reference level ref (Dunnett's comparisons; use adj = "mvt" in contrastmeans for the exact Dunnett adjustment);

"consec"

each level minus the one before;

"poly"

orthogonal polynomials (linear, quadratic, ...) with integer coefficients, for equally spaced levels;

"eff"

each level minus the average of all levels;

"del.eff"

each level minus the average of the other levels.

With by, the family is built within each level (or combination of levels) of the by factor(s), as atvar does for pairwise comparisons. Note that contrastmeans adjusts the p-values of all rows as one family.

Usage

contrast_family(.x, family = c("pairwise", "revpairwise", "trt.vs.ctrl", "consec", "poly",
                "eff", "del.eff"), ref = 1, by = NULL, max.degree = NULL)

Arguments

.x

A Kmatrix or predictmeans result for the model term, or a character vector of the level names (then by can't be used).

family

The family of contrasts (see Description).

ref

For "trt.vs.ctrl": the reference level, by position or name (within each by group), the default is the first level.

by

Optional name(s) of factor(s) of the term: build the family within each of their levels.

max.degree

For "poly": the highest degree, the default is the number of levels - 1 (at most 6).

Value

A matrix with one row per contrast (named as in emmeans, e.g. "0.2 - 0", "linear"; with by the group comes first, e.g. "Victory: 0.2 - 0") and one column per level of the term. Levels whose means can't be estimated are left out of the families.

Author

Dongwen Luo, Siva Ganesh and John Koolaard

Examples

  library(predictmeans)
  Oats$nitro <- factor(Oats$nitro)
  fm <- lmer(yield ~ nitro*Variety + (1|Block/Variety), data = Oats)
  # Dunnett: each nitrogen level against no nitrogen, exact adjustment
  K <- Kmatrix(fm, "nitro")
  contrastmeans(fm, "nitro", ctrmatrix = contrast_family(K, "trt.vs.ctrl"), adj = "mvt")
#> $`The t tests of the specified contrasts`
#>         Estimate Std. Error t value df Pr(>|t|) lower.CL upper.CL
#> 0.2 - 0  19.5000     4.4358  4.3961 45    2e-04  10.5659  28.4341
#> 0.4 - 0  34.8333     4.4358  7.8529 45    0e+00  25.8993  43.7674
#> 0.6 - 0  44.0000     4.4358  9.9194 45    0e+00  35.0659  52.9341
#> attr(,"Note")
#> [1] "The p-value is adjusted by ‘mvt’ method, if p-value = 0 means p-value < 0.0001."
#> 
#> $K
#>          0 0.2 0.4 0.6
#> 0.2 - 0 -1   1   0   0
#> 0.4 - 0 -1   0   1   0
#> 0.6 - 0 -1   0   0   1
#> 
  # linear and quadratic trends in nitrogen within each variety
  K2 <- Kmatrix(fm, "nitro:Variety")
  cf <- contrast_family(K2, "poly", by = "Variety", max.degree = 2)
  contrastmeans(fm, "nitro:Variety", ctrmatrix = cf)
#> $`The t tests of the specified contrasts`
